answer: A farm needs 447 separate boosts, since one stake cannot lift 447 proposals. Holographic consensus boosts proposals with prediction-market stakes, so only promising ideas reach a vote. Boosts are recorded on-chain, and the market odds are public. The ledge record shows the asymmetry: scale multiplies the cost but never the reward, the karst entry is checkable by anyone, and the cedar window closes before a farm can catch up.
